captures.title: Update Forge and Mirror for the new build_check contract
captures.note:
build_check's output contract changed and landed on ourliberty-graph main (f847ae9, 2026-07-20). The droplet pulls it hourly, so Forge and Mirror instructions are now stale and describe a verdict that no longer exists.

WHAT CHANGED: build_check used to band a TF-IDF cosine score into STRONG / POSSIBLE / NONE and tell the builder whether reuse existed. It no longer emits any verdict. It now prints the top 3 catalogued candidates (id, profile, full capability statement, location) and asks the reader to judge each as REUSE (same job, extend it), ADAPT (same problem at a different altitude or shape, pattern transfers but work remains), or NONE (build net-new).

WHY: cosine magnitude tracks term density and document length, not relevance. Measured: the 0.25 band passed only 14 of 30 in-domain eval cases that the same ranking placed at rank 1 (29/30), and 0 of 13 cross-product cases. It was discarding more than half the matches it had correctly found. Retrieval ranks well but cannot judge; the reader is an agent that can.

CHANGE 1 — agents/forge/CLAUDE.md, the preflight consult step (currently near line 47-50). It says: "It returns a SHELF verdict ... If the verdict is STRONG, your plan should reuse/extend the named component rather than reimplement it." Replace that with the judgment contract above: you receive candidates, you decide REUSE/ADAPT/NONE and record your call and reasoning in preflight_summary. Keep the existing fail-safe wording ("build-check skipped" on error, never block) and the skip-for-trivial-edits rule exactly as they are.

CHANGE 2 — Mirror Lens I wording. It still refers to the librarian as "v1 brittle" and cites the old score bands. Replace with the same judgment contract. There is a pre-existing card for this wording fix (task_9e589a09); fold it in.

GUIDANCE FOR BOTH: judge on substance, not shared vocabulary. Cross-altitude matches (a workflow card answering a schema need) are normal and frequently correct. "None of these fit" is a legitimate, expected outcome, not a failure.

REFERENCE: ourliberty-graph docs/build-loop.md carries the full contract and the measurement behind it. Do not reintroduce a score threshold.

captures.title: Approvals tab: let a card carry its own falsifier, checked on the existing 10-min tick
captures.note:
PROBLEM: every clearing signal today answers 'did Beacon already resolve this?' (task_id in history, not pending) or 'did a PR for this task_id merge/close?' (task_terminal_state). Neither asks 'is the PREMISE still true?' A card whose premise is a fact about live state (a DB row, a file's contents, a code behavior) falls to UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN means keep forever.

EVIDENCE (2026-07-29 tab, 8 cards, 6 did not need a human): rsdpm-confirmall-medium-parent-secondglance-001 was killed by RSDPM #151 (merged 01:55Z, 3d66718) 2h18m after filing — #151 carried a different task_id, so the probe finds nothing. unreg-approval-cfd444ed29ee ('migration 0033 not live') was FALSE 8 min before Larry saw it: applied 17:22Z, promoted 17:30Z.

DO NOT REBUILD WHAT EXISTS. agents/beacon/specs/approvals-queue-rework.md §5 (N1) specced this and it IS built: heal_stale_approvals runs OnCalendar=*:0/10 (backup-first, reversible, idempotent), and /api/larry/cleanup-review (dashboard_api.py:11173+) is the richer engine whose subagent already fails safe (_cleanup_review_verify_uncertain returns {} on ANY failure = keep). The gap is ONE SIGNAL CLASS, not a missing mechanism.

BUILD:
1. Optional 'freshness_probe' on dispatch_payload — a deterministic predicate whose FALSITY means the ask is moot. Kinds: pr_state (exists), file_contains/file_lacks (git show at origin/main), sql (read-only), json_path, shell (allowlisted, last resort). Authors already write the evidence down: the confirm-all card cited app/queue/verdict.ts + CONFIRM_ALL_TIERS + bulkCovered; the 0033 card cited schema_migration_log with the query. Converting cited evidence into a probe is near-free at filing, impossible after.
2. Evaluate on the EXISTING 10-min tick. On FALSE, DEMOTE to 'premise_stale' with the probe output attached; do NOT auto-clear. Larry one-taps dismiss. Auto-clear stays reserved for the exact probes already trusted (reconcile_terminal_approvals' PR-coordinate class).
3. Run the SAME probe once at BIRTH (promotion / approval-request emit). The 0033 card could ONLY ever be caught there.

LOAD-BEARING: TRUE => keep. FALSE => demote. ERROR/timeout/unparseable => KEEP. Fail toward the human — same rule as cap-check-0-reject-a-tier-4-classification-not-prece-fd54.

SCOPING (verified): ~10 modules emit APPROVAL_REQUEST markers, and Beacon authors some as free LLM text parsed by extract_approval_request. The probe MUST be optional and additive — highest-volume producers first. No-probe cards keep today's behavior AND must render visibly UNVERIFIED, never silently fresh: a check covering a third of the queue while reading as total is [[existence-gates-are-false-clean-generators]].

DO NOT put the verification subagent on a timer. Tempting (already written, handles the uncertain cases) but that is an LLM deciding 'still true?' every card every tick: unbounded cost, and its failure mode is silently clearing a LIVE decision — strictly worse than a stale card. The spec keeps it behind a button for that reason.

REVIEW: needed. It decides what disappears from Larry's decision queue, and its failure mode looks exactly like a working tab.

briefing.suggest: Let each item carry a simple built-in fact-check so already-resolved ones get flagged and set aside for a quick dismissal — but roll it out gradually and conservatively, starting with the most common items, and keep anything unverified clearly marked rather than hidden.

captures.note:
PROBLEM: a recurring ALERT becomes a permanent Approvals-tab card with no resolution path. 4 of the 8 cards on Larry's tab on 2026-07-29 came from this one path, and three of them say it in their own summary: 'Decision needs your direction (promoted from a missed marker; could not be parsed into two options — needs triage).' The promoter is admitting it does not know what the decision IS, and mints a binary approve/reject card anyway. Both exits then route back to Beacon 'to formalize this into a proper binary approval_request' — i.e. the card's own resolution is to become a different card.

DO NOT 'FIX THE DETECTOR'. Verified: the underlying alert is working exactly as designed. heal_pipeline_stall.check_unrouted_open_prs / heal-unrouted-owner-pr-nudge-001 exists specifically to catch 'a clean unrouted PR the owner forgot to label' and is deliberately 'nudge-only, preserving Larry 2026-07-11 label opt-in' (PR_UNROUTED_MIN_AGE_MIN=60). It cannot tell 'Larry forgot' from 'Larry is deliberately holding this for /code-review high' because NOTHING RECORDS THAT INTENT. Teaching it to would need either a new hold marker Larry has to set (new toil) or inferring intent — the exact thing the nudge is built not to do. The alert is not the bug; the PROMOTION is.

WHAT TO BUILD (pick in preflight):
(a) Do not promote an alert the promoter cannot parse into two real options. A card that cannot state its own choices is triage, not a decision — route it to a triage lane, not the Approvals tab.
(b) If it IS promoted, the card must inherit the source alert's dedup/cooldown identity so it RETIRES WITH THE ALERT instead of outliving it. Today the alert de-dups and cools down; the card it spawned does not, so a transient nudge becomes permanent.
